theorem upper_sieve (supp : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (P : Set ℕ) (Q : Finset ℕ)
    (g : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (z D : ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n) (hsupp : ∀ n, n ∉ supp → a n = 0)
    (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime) (hQ : ↑Q ⊆ P)
    (hg : ∀ n, ∀ p ∈ P, 0 ≤ g n p ∧ g n p < 1) (hz : 2 ≤ z)
    (hprod : ∀ n u, 1 < u → u < z →
      ∏ p ∈ (range ⌈z⌉₊).filter (fun p => p ∈ P ∧ p ∉ Q ∧ u ≤ (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) < z),
        (1 - g n p)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + (1 / 8349 : ℝ)) * (log z / log u))
    (hzD : z ≤ D) (hs : log D / log z ≤ 3) :
    sifted supp a P z ≤
      (2 * exp eulerMascheroniConstant / (log D / log z) +
        (1 / 8349 : ℝ) * 112 * exp 2 * hS (log D / log z)) * mainMass supp a P g z +
      errorSum supp a P Q g z D

theorem delay_partial_sums (s : ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    (1 ≤ s → s ≤ 3 →
      (∑ n ∈ range N, if n % 2 = 1 then delayTerm n s else 0) ≤
        2 * exp eulerMascheroniConstant / s - 1) ∧
    (2 ≤ s → s ≤ 4 →
      (∑ n ∈ range N, if 0 < n ∧ n % 2 = 0 then delayTerm n s else 0) ≤
        1 - 2 * exp eulerMascheroniConstant * log (s - 1) / s)

theorem upper_stopping_error (P : Set ℕ) (Q : Finset ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) (z D : ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime) (hg : ∀ p ∈ P, 0 ≤ g p ∧ g p < 1)
    (hz : 2 ≤ z)
    (hprod : ∀ u, 1 < u → u < z →
      ∏ p ∈ (range ⌈z⌉₊).filter (fun p => p ∈ P ∧ p ∉ Q ∧ u ≤ (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) < z),
        (1 - g p)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + (1 / 8349 : ℝ)) * (log z / log u))
    (hzD : z ≤ D) (hs : log D / log z ≤ 3) :
    (∑ n ∈ range ((siftingPrimes P z \ Q).card + 3),
      if n % 2 = 1 then
        stoppingTerm (siftingPrimes P z \ Q) D g n -
          (∏ p ∈ siftingPrimes P z \ Q, (1 - g p)) * delayTerm n (log D / log z)
      else 0) ≤
      (∏ p ∈ siftingPrimes P z \ Q, (1 - g p)) *
        ((1 / 8349 : ℝ) * 112 * exp 2 * hS (log D / log z))

theorem lower_stopping_error (P : Set ℕ) (Q : Finset ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) (z D : ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime) (hg : ∀ p ∈ P, 0 ≤ g p ∧ g p < 1)
    (hz : 2 ≤ z)
    (hprod : ∀ u, 1 < u → u < z →
      ∏ p ∈ (range ⌈z⌉₊).filter (fun p => p ∈ P ∧ p ∉ Q ∧ u ≤ (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) < z),
        (1 - g p)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + (1 / 8349 : ℝ)) * (log z / log u))
    (hzD : z ^ 2 ≤ D) (hs : log D / log z ≤ 4) :
    (∑ n ∈ range ((siftingPrimes P z \ Q).card + 3),
      if 0 < n ∧ n % 2 = 0 then
        stoppingTerm (siftingPrimes P z \ Q) D g n -
          (∏ p ∈ siftingPrimes P z \ Q, (1 - g p)) * delayTerm n (log D / log z)
      else 0) ≤
      (∏ p ∈ siftingPrimes P z \ Q, (1 - g p)) *
        ((1 / 8349 : ℝ) * 114 * exp 2 * hS (log D / log z))

theorem primitive_term_cap (hG : GRH) (c : ℕ → ℂ) (X Y Z D D₀ : ℝ) (r s : ℕ)

theorem main_at_threshold (α A u ε C₁ X₂ ε₁ : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁) (he0 : 0 < ε) (hε₁ : 0 < ε₁) (hε₁1 : ε₁ < 1)
    (hα : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1 / 16) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hc : Cond25 α A u X₂) (hX : exp (exp 10) ≤ X₂) (hn : X₂ ≤ (n : ℝ))
    (hm : mass n ε₁ ≤ massBound n ε₁) :
    mass n ε₁ * sieveCoefficient n α ε C₁ ≤

theorem remainder_bound (α A u X₂ ε₁ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hG : GRH)

theorem rosser_upper_model (supp : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (P : Set ℕ) (Q : Finset ℕ)
    (g : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (z D : ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a n) (hsupp : ∀ n, n ∉ supp → a n = 0)
    (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime) (hQ : ↑Q ⊆ P)
    (hg : ∀ n, ∀ p ∈ P, 0 ≤ g n p ∧ g n p < 1) (hz : 2 ≤ z)
    (hprod : ∀ n u, 1 < u → u < z →
      ∏ p ∈ (range ⌈z⌉₊).filter (fun p => p ∈ P ∧ p ∉ Q ∧ u ≤ (p : ℝ) ∧ (p : ℝ) < z),
        (1 - g n p)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + (1 / 8349 : ℝ)) * (log z / log u))
    (hzD : z ≤ D) (hs : log D / log z ≤ 3) :
    weightedModel supp a P Q g z D (rosserSubsetWeight P Q z D true) ≤
        (2 * exp eulerMascheroniConstant / (log D / log z) +
          (1 / 8349 : ℝ) * 112 * exp 2 * hS (log D / log z)) * mainMass supp a P g z

theorem rosser_lower_model (supp : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (P : Set ℕ) (Q : Finset ℕ)
    (g : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (z D : ℝ)

        (1 - g n p)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + (1 / 8349 : ℝ)) * (log z / log u))
    (hzD : z ^ 2 ≤ D) (hs : log D / log z ≤ 4) :
